mission: Extend deterministic curriculum planning with bounded evidence assessment, mandatory NONE comparison, and structural research-frontier navigation without promoting software outputs into educational or scientific truth.

triad.C: capability evidence sufficient under explicit caller policy
triad.F: frontier distance from declared evidence-qualified capabilities
triad.R: reality level and independence metadata remain evidence attributes, never automatic external truth

hard_invariants: NONE is always a first-class curriculum option
m_minus: duplicate evidence identifiers must fail closed
multiple records from one independent source must not fake source diversity
invalid evidence must not count toward policy sufficiency
frontier labels are caller inputs and do not prove novelty
structural plan minimization must retain NONE baseline
next_frontier: counterfactual prerequisite ablation with measured outcomes
proof-carrying credentials only after independent qualification
